resources.string:
If your phone is stolen, send it an SMS containing exactly:

 %1$s

from any phone. The phone will then announce "This phone is stolen" with a siren at full volume and text its GPS location to your trusted numbers. Nobody can turn the volume down; the alarm stops only when the phone is unlocked with your PIN, pattern, password or fingerprint.
The alarm stops when the phone is unlocked, so the phone must have a PIN, pattern or password. Otherwise anyone can stop it.
Needed to detect the \"Stolen\" message, text the location and show the alarm.
Lets the alarm screen appear over the lock screen.
Stops the system from delaying or killing the alarm.
Locks the phone the moment the alarm starts, so even a thief who has the phone open must know your PIN to stop it.
Enable \"Theft Guard volume lock\" in Accessibility settings. The volume buttons then do nothing while the alarm sounds. (Even without this, the volume is forced back to maximum instantly.)
Allows the app to switch off Do Not Disturb while the alarm sounds.
Trusted numbers (get the GPS location by SMS)

While the alarm is sounding, the phone texts its location (a Google Maps link) to these numbers, straight away and then every 5 minutes, and texts again when it is unlocked. Only these numbers get the location, whoever sends \"Stolen\". Separate numbers with commas.
Enter at least one number below (e.g. your other phone or a family member).
Needed to find the phone\'s GPS position.
The location is sent while the phone is locked, so choose \"Allow all the time\" in the location permission.
Apps can\'t switch location on by themselves, so keep it on.

THEFT GUARD: last known location (getting a fresh fix)
https://maps.google.com/?q=%1$.6f,%2$.6f
Accuracy: %3$d m
Time: %4$s
Battery: %5$d%%
THEFT GUARD: alarm is ON but location is turned off on the phone. Battery: %1$d%%
THEFT GUARD: alarm is ON but the app has no location permission. Battery: %1$d%%
THEFT GUARD: phone was unlocked at %1$s, alarm stopped. Battery: %2$d%%
Theft Guard locks the screen when the \"Stolen\" alarm is triggered, so only you can unlock the phone and stop the alarm.
Blocks the volume buttons only while the theft alarm is sounding, so a thief cannot turn it down. It does not read or collect any content.

The alarm will sound at full volume. It stops only when the phone is unlocked. If \"Lock screen on alarm\" is enabled the phone locks immediately; otherwise lock the phone with the power button and unlock it again to stop the alarm.
Shown while the theft alarm is sounding
The alarm stops only when the owner unlocks this phone.
If you found this phone, please hand it in to the police.
